source_pr.title: Add Context() method to CloseIterator for context propagation in streaming queries

blast_radius_note: EntryIterator and SampleIterator are both type aliases for StreamIterator which embeds v2.CloseIterator. All concrete structs implementing either interface across ~47 files in loki must add Context(). Key implementors include: pkg/iter/entry_iterator.go (multiple structs), pkg/iter/cache.go, pkg/iter/sample_iterator.go, pkg/iter/categorized_labels_iterator.go, pkg/chunkenc/memchunk.go, pkg/chunkenc/variants.go, pkg/chunkenc/dumb_chunk.go, pkg/storage/batch.go, pkg/querier/multi_tenant_querier.go, pkg/logql/evaluator.go. The noOpIterator and errorIterator generic helpers in pkg/iter/iterator.go must also gain Context(). Grafana imports the loki/pkg/push package which may also be affected through its iterator wrappers.
